description: This file defines the ExtensionVersion class, a value object for handling extension version strings in Drupal, including parsing and validation logic.

classes.name: ExtensionVersion
classes.description: A value object representing an extension's version, with methods for parsing version strings and support branches.

methods.name: createFromVersionString
methods.description: Creates an ExtensionVersion object from a version string, parsing major, minor, and extra parts.

methods.name: createFromSupportBranch
methods.description: Creates an ExtensionVersion object from a support branch string, appending '0' to the branch.

methods.name: getVersionExtra
methods.description: Returns the extra version string, such as 'alpha1' or 'dev'.
